meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: Claude会扫描你的代码库，提取业务领域、流程和步骤，然后生成一个交互式流程图在仪表盘里展示。如果已有知识图谱，会直接利用它来派生领域知识。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude理解或分析代码库的业务领域时，或者指定使用“understand-domain”命令时触发。可选地，加上“--full”强制重新扫描。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase, extracts business domains, flows, and process steps, then generates an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard. It can also derive domain knowledge from an existing knowledge graph if present.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to understand or analyze the business domain of a codebase, or when you use the "understand-domain" command. Optionally, use "--full" to force a fresh scan.

say_en.text: Analyze the business domains and flows of this project.
say_en.note: Triggers domain extraction and flow graph generation

say_en.text: Extract domain knowledge from the codebase.
say_en.note: Generates an interactive domain flow graph

say_en.text: Show the business domain structure of the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will launch the dashboard to display it
